title: AI Mission Guidance Foundation
goal: Add grounded operator guidance that explains run choices and follow-up recommendations without letting AI execute or broaden scope.
scope: Implement the first AI mission-guidance slice by deriving explanation text and next-step suggestions from deterministic scope, inventory, findings, relevance, and pack provenance. Keep execution deterministic and operator-controlled.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep AI guidance explanatory and grounded. Do not add autonomous execution, new scan scope, or generic chat.
notes: AI guidance must cite deterministic inputs or evidence categories.
Operators must remain able to override or ignore suggestions.

success_criteria: The UI can explain why a profile, safety posture, or follow-up action is recommended using existing deterministic data.
Guidance never expands target scope or authorization.
AI output is disabled/fallback-safe where provider configuration is absent or fails.
Tests cover grounded guidance, fallback behavior, and no-scope-expansion rules.
must_not_touch: pack validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Guidance is traceable to deterministic data.
Provider failure or disabled AI leaves deterministic behavior intact.
No autonomous execution or scope expansion is added.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The guidance surface is explicitly selected before implementation starts.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with AI guidance changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the AI guidance baseline and remaining AI limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
